body.text: I am obliged to write to you about the accounts, which I would rather not have had to do this early.
The returns are {perception:purse}. Against them the Crown has laid out {param:amount} on your undertakings this year, and the arithmetic of that is not obscure.
Nobody is alarmed. I want to be precise about that, because I find men hear alarm in any letter from this office. We are not alarmed. We have noticed.
There are two remedies and you know both of them. Do more with what you have, or raise the duties. I have an opinion as to which, and you will not be surprised by it.
